description: This file defines the 'Module' class within the Opencart Admin Model Setting namespace, responsible for CRUD operations on modules in the database such as adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving modules and their related data.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A class that manages module records in the database within the Opencart admin setting context.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Inserts a new module record into the database and returns the primary key ID.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates an existing module record identified by $module_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module record from the database based on $module_id.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules with a specific code and associated layout modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a module's settings data based on its ID.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves modules filtered by specific code.
